description: This PHP source file defines the ViewResetmodule class, which manages the reset operations for modules within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for displaying the reset interface, handling reset actions such as removing custom fields, layouts, relationships, labels, and extensions, and coordinates the resetting process through an AJAX interface.

classes.name: ViewResetmodule
classes.description: A class extending SugarView, responsible for managing the reset operations of module customizations in SuiteCRM. It provides methods to display the reset interface, process reset actions like removing custom fields, layouts, relationships, labels, and extensions, and generate AJAX responses for these operations.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the module, used in interface headers.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the reset interface with breadcrumbs and options, or handles the reset process if 'execute' is requested.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes the reset request, removing specified module customizations and updating the interface.

methods.name: removeCustomFields
methods.description: Deletes custom fields created through Studio, excluding certain exception fields.

methods.name: removeCustomLayouts
methods.description: Removes metadata layout files for the module and clears cache.

methods.name: removeCustomRelationships
methods.description: Deletes custom relationships involving the module.

methods.name: removeCustomLabels
methods.description: Deletes language label files for the module.

methods.name: removeCustomExtensions
methods.description: Removes custom extension directories and rebuilds extensions.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates module title parameters for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the reset interface or processes reset commands.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Executes reset operations based on request parameters.

methods.name: removeCustomFields
